notes.title: Now available in Spanish, French and Italian!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/d7d73373d3bb3e5cd8f26555a78abec3ad7fa4a1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]Our award-winning retro point-and-click comedy [i]Lucy Dreaming[/i] is now bringing its uniquely British wit, brain-teasing puzzles, and nostalgic 90s pixel-art to a wider new audience with its 11,000+ lines of dialogue now localised into French, Spanish, and Italian (to join the English and German versions already released).[/p][p]Special attention has been given to "culturalising" many of the game's jokes, wordplays, and references to preserve the humour and provide the same engaging experience for players in all languages.[/p][p]We'd like to extend our heartfelt thanks to Concha Fernández (Spanish), Christophe Pallarès (French) and Fabio "Guga" Guggeri (Italian) for their awesome localisation expertise, support and patience! ❤️[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532710/Lucy_Dreaming/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Yay, we're so happy that we've been able to provide this for you![/p][p][b]Don't forget to leave a lovely review!![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Tom x[/p]

notes.title: Lucy Dreaming in French, Spanish and Italian - July 31st
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/6b37e5c1ee9b355d15ba553084348afab365cbce.png"][/img][/p][h2]Three more languages[/h2][p]From July 31st, French, Spanish, and Italian players will be able to laugh, smile, and groan in all the same places as English and German-speaking players, with localisations crafted for cultural authenticity.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/9cb810f8b3b0058db769c7db74f45c12835367b2.gif"][/img][/p][p]Careful attention has been paid to translating the game’s wit, wordplay, and cultural quirks, ensuring that jokes and puns work naturally in other languages, rather than being simply translated.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/9bda283d5f3d7f418f38066f882f870f129d9616.gif"][/img]This has been a lot of work for everyone involved, and we would like to applaud the incredible [u][url="https://bsky.app/profile/frenchchriss.bsky.social"]Christophe Pallares[/url][/u], [u][url="https://bsky.app/profile/gugames.eu"]Fabio “Guga” Guggeri[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://bsky.app/profile/cfernandez.me"]Concha Fernández[/url][/u] for the tremendous effort they’ve put into localising all the ridiculous concepts, puns and made-up words in our game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/8a0213c2945ca45bfcf9bd2b7e3580929bc84055.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’ve poured so much heart into this game, and we’re excited for more people to experience its humour, puzzles, and charm for the first time.[/p]

notes.title: Please please please leave a review... please!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/c81c55ea82b98becce50989fe2d1088dbd2a4c56.jpg[/img]

Since releasing Lucy Dreaming last year, we've seen incredible support and love for our very first commercial game. We reached 100 reviews really quickly, but we need more, and here's why...

[h2]Did you know...[/h2]
[b]...the vast majority of new players will come via suggestions made by Steam within their own platform?[/b] Steam's algorithm uses the number of reviews to dictate how often (and how prominently) each game is shown to new potential players as they browse and play.

[b]...the first algorithm milestone is 10 reviews.[/b]
This is basically Steam's way of making sure that a game isn't a complete crash-fest.

[b]...next is at 50-reviews.[/b]
This is where a game can earn its [b]Very Positive[/b] rating, depending on the positivity of the reviews.

[b]...the next milestone is a whopping 500 reviews![/b]
This would give us an [b]Overwhelmingly Positive[/b] rating and a top spot in Steam's algorithm. We're already over 30% of the way there, but [b]every single review counts[/b] and improves our chances of being displayed to more potential point & click fans.

[h2]What can you do?[/h2]
It's simple, and only takes a minute! If you have enjoyed playing Lucy Dreaming, please, please, please spare a few seconds to write a short review and help us to reach that [b]magic 500 reviews[/b]!

It really will have an enormous impact, and enable us to create more games in the future.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532710/Lucy_Dreaming/

Thank you, and I really hope you've enjoyed playing our game.

Tom x

notes.title: Enjoyed Lucy Dreaming? Time to sniff out a new point & click adventure...
notes.notes:
After a staggering 50,000 downloads of Hair of the Dog (our game jam submission built in just 12 days), we are delighted to announce that a full length Cummerbund Bandersnatch adventure is in the making.

Inspired by Robert Louis Stevenson’s classic Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431920/Heir_of_the_Dog/]Heir of the Dog[/url] takes you on a riotous romp through the dark streets and back alleys of Victorian London, where you’ll discover talking lice, cannibalism, a secret society and rather a lot of dogs.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431920/Heir_of_the_Dog/

If you loved Lucy Dreaming's sardonic British humour and twisting narrative, you can look forward to the same brand of sarcasm, horrendous puns and nob jokes as you explore the dark underbelly of Victorian London in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431920/Heir_of_the_Dog/]Heir of the Dog[/url]!

[previewyoutube=9PZYdtgHi90;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Introducing: Heir of the Dog
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431920/Heir_of_the_Dog/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/0c32cfb898bab1feaeed0cd6ec1be1ca5d5a424d.jpg[/img][/url]

If you have followed my journey into game development over the past few years, you'll probably be aware of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1558970/Hair_of_the_Dog/]Hair of the Dog[/url], a short adventure game I created for AdvXJam back in 2020. It was created in twelve days, so was a little rough around the edges, but pipped [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532710/Lucy_Dreaming/]Lucy Dreaming[/url] to the post as the first game I ever released on Steam. In that respect it was a great test-run, paving the way for Lucy two years later.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1558970/Hair_of_the_Dog/]Hair of the Dog[/url] has enjoyed over 25,000 downloads on various platforms since it was released, and I have received hundreds of messages and reviews from people all over the world requesting a full length version.

[h1]Well, here it is![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431920/Heir_of_the_Dog/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431920/Heir_of_the_Dog/]Heir of the Dog[/url] will return to the fog-covered streets of Victorian London to expand on the life of Cummerbund Bandersnatch and his curious condition.

[previewyoutube=Sf4RvyPpPMg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Demo coming soon![/h2]
The demo is tantalisingly almost finished, with the voices being recorded as I type, but that shouldn't stop anyone from adding it to their wishlist (we all know how the Steam algorithm loves a wishlist!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/3a0c17fafb7afdf40f6b42adc88852e3318debf7.png[/img]

The demo is predominantly a recreation of the original Game Jam game from 2020 so, if you've played it before, the majority of the puzzles and dialogue will be familiar to you, but I have applied everything I learned whilst developing Lucy Dreaming in terms of the improved UI, controller support and artwork. So, even if you have met Cummerbund before, why not clear the fog with a stroll down Memory Lane when the demo is released. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/2845656f71e433240579717ebd4124303336bea4.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2431920/Heir_of_the_Dog/][h2]Add it to your wishlist now[/h2][/url]

notes.title: Lucy Dreaming Soundtrack now available
notes.notes:
Since releasing Lucy Dreaming back in October 2023, people have fallen in love with its retro soundtrack produced in both AdLib Sound Blaster and Roland MT32 styles.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2462140/Lucy_Dreaming_Soundtrack/

We are now delighted to announce that we have made the full soundtrack available to download as DLC on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2462140/Lucy_Dreaming_Soundtrack/]Steam[/url]!

[previewyoutube=dMxT3IdwbCM;full][/previewyoutube]Listen to some samples

[h2]Here's what you get[/h2]
[list]
[*] 26 original tracks from Lucy Dreaming
[*] 2 bonus tracks never used in the final game
[*] Both Roland MT32 and AdLib sound card styles for each track
[*] High quality FLAC and MP3 formats
[/list]

[h2]The genius behind the music[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/9343bdf94504c34eab43a58bc330f807ef8a4a02.jpg[/img]
[url=https://linktr.ee/bertrandguegan]Bertrand Guégan[/url] is a composer and teacher specialising in orchestral, metal and acoustic music. He has a real soft spot for retro video games from the "golden age" and, growing up in the 1990s, he enjoyed music through the soundcards available at the time, the AdLib Sound Blaster, and Roland MT32.

His passion for point & click adventure games shines through in this collection of atmospheric soundscapes from Lucy's dream worlds and her hometown of Figgington, all available in both soundcard styles.

[url=https://linktr.ee/bertrandguegan]Find out more about Bertrand here[/url]

notes.title: How Steam reviews work
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/3fc3d7ac64ea4b1353931df6b05f5d5924ae0941.png[/img]

We have seen incredible support and love for Lucy Dreaming since it released back in October, reaching 100 reviews really quickly, but we need more, and here's why...

Did you know that thew vast majority of a Steam game's players come via suggestions made by Steam within their own platform? Steam's algorithm uses the number of reviews to dictate how often (and prominently) each game will be shown to new potential players as they browse and play.

[b]The first algorithm milestone is 10 reviews.[/b]
This is basically Steam's way of making sure that a game isn't a complete crash-fest.

[b]Next is the 50-review milestone.[/b]
This is where a game can earn its [b]Very Positive[/b] rating, depending on the positivity of the reviews.

BUT... the next milestone is a whopping 500 reviews!
This would give us an [b]Overwhelmingly Positive[/b] rating and a top spot in Steam's algorithm. We're already over 20% of the way there, but every single review counts and improves our chances of being displayed to more potential point & click fans.

So, if you have enjoyed playing Lucy Dreaming, please spare a few seconds to write a short review and help us to reach that [b]magic 500 reviews[/b] ! It really will have an enormous impact, and enable us to create more games in the future.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532710/Lucy_Dreaming/

Thank you, and I really hope you've enjoyed playing the game.

Tom x

notes.title: Audio overhaul
notes.notes:
Along with a couple of little tweaks to the game, the main reason for this update is to try and fix an issue which was causing the game to randomly crash (usually while streaming publicly...which is doubly annoying).

[b]A bit of background info[/b]
The codec for the .ogg vorbis format I was using occasionally seemed to trigger crashes on some platforms, and I'm wondering if it's this that has caused the occasional crashing that some of us have seen on Windows 10 systems too.

I have now replaced all of the .ogg files with .opus files which has not only reduced the overall size of the game, it may actually fix the crashing too! 🤞

I have tested it at my end and didn't notice any issues with it running or loading previously saved games, but if anyone spots the game doing anything weird from an audio point of view, please do let me know.

Sorry this update is a bit heavier than the usual tweaks, but a large portion of the game's weight has been replaced with the new audio files.

Fingers crossed!

Tom

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/3fc3d7ac64ea4b1353931df6b05f5d5924ae0941.png[/img]

We have seen incredible support and love for Lucy Dreaming, and managed to reach Steam's first two review milestones (10 and 50) really quickly. This is fantastic and has given Lucy Dreaming a [b]Very Positive[/b] rating!

The next review milestone is a bit more daunting at 500 reviews!
This will give us an [b]Overwhelmingly Positive[/b] rating and a top spot in Steam's algorithm. It may seem like a hard goal to achive, but we honestly believe that by tackling it one review at a time, we can reach it before we all die of old age.

If you have enjoyed playing Lucy Dreaming, please spare a few seconds to write a short review and help us to reach that [b]magic 500 reviews[/b] ! It really will have an enormous impact, and enable us to create more games in the future.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532710/Lucy_Dreaming/

Thank you, and I really hope you've enjoyed playing the game.

Tom x

notes.title: Fixes and a slightly adapted ending
notes.notes:
[b]Some fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Small typos
[*] Steam achievement fix for one of the badges - if you earned a badge but didn't earn the Steam achievement to go along with it, you can load up a savegame with the badge and Steam will reward you accordingly (alternatively, you can just earn it again if you prefer) :)
[*] Fixes to some clickable hotspots (one which caused a DMW dead end!)
[*] A patch to prevent the unintentional "Spiderman" easter egg which allowed Lucy to climb some walls.
[/list]

[b]Known issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Mac - On some Macs with Apple Silicon, the mouse can get a bit stuck in one corner of the screen. We are working on a fix for this.
[*] Linux - Audio can distort or judder on some systems, try disabling surround sound if this occurs.
[*] Windows - The game rarely, but occasionally crashes with no log or report. We believe this is caused by graphics drivers on some machines. If it happens, you chould be able to continue from when you entered the last scene with the autosave.
[/list]

The ending has been tweaked slightly. I don't want to go into detail as tit will contain spoilers, but if you want to read about it, there is a comment thread on Steam which goes into some detail.

Tom

notes.title: Fix to game restart
notes.notes:
After the game is completed, it was my intention to have it conduct a fresh "restart" so a new game could be played right away without any issues... I'm not entirely sure why I thought this was necessary, it just seemed like the right thing to do.

Unfortunately this appears to generate an error on MacOS and causes a crash, so I have removed this action from the game.

If (for some reason) players do want to start a new game right away after completing, simply close the game and restart it manually.

Tom

notes.notes:

[olist]
[*] I've fixed a couple of typos in some of the dialogue
[*] I've tried to remedy a bug where, remarkably, Lucy was able to walk halfway up a brick wall in one of the scenes (if this one persists we might rename it the Spiderman achievement and run with it).

notes.title: Witty Monkey Island style adventure game Lucy Dreaming hits Steam
notes.notes:
If you're a fan of Monkey Island style adventure games, the newly released Lucy Dreaming might be next on your list. Following in the footsteps of overwhelmingly positive Return to Monkey Island reviews for Guybrush Threepwood's return, developer Tall Story Games hopes to win over fans with Lucy Dreaming's delightfully British sense of humour and its old-school point-and-click puzzle design.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Only one day to go...
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/9beb927fdd86158de50c42a74523bb35cba2501a.jpg[/img]

Lucy Dreaming is a retro British point & click adventure packed with nightmares, mystery, jam and weasels. Here are some things to look forward to...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/63cde1a93d928a7430f3dd0b817dc5ebc8e336a6.jpg[/img]

[h2]A traditional-feeling game with tonnes of modern features.[/h2]
Lucy Dreaming is very much a love-letter to the 1990s classic LucasArts adventure games, with a visible inventory and a pared-down verb-based interface like you'd find in the original Monkey Island games.
But we've also added some more features to make exploring the game easier and quicker for those of us with busy lives.

[b]Get all nostalgia, with none of the frustration (unless you hate puzzles of course).[/b]

[list]
[*] Over 11,000 lines of fully-voiced and lip-synced dialogue.
[*] A hotspot finder: Hold down the space bar or press the ? at the bottom to reveal the important objects in each scene.
[*] Double-click any exit to leave that scene immediately.
[*] Collect in-game badges and Steam achievements.
[*] A range of keyboard hot keys to select commands, skip text/cutscenes, access your map and change audio/display settings.
[*] Multiple music styles: Press "M" or access the audio menu during the game to toggle between AdLib Sound Blaster and Roland MT32 music styles.
[*] 12 savegame slots.
[*] German subtitles and UI.
[*] Gamepad support
[*] All game design, writing, artwork and development was the work of a single indie dev!
[/list]

[h2]Even Monkey Island's creator has it on his wishlist![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/e831e7bacb4e27e8c434ad77cf94fe6e2a2ba58a.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/90ec327060a38b320c0478a18a423ffcec0e898a.jpg[/img]

[h2]A generous 15% launch discount![/h2]
That's right, the game will already be reasonably priced (bearing in mind the 10-12 hours average game length), but that's not enough! For the first week, we'll be releasing the game with a staggering 15% off.

[h2]Add it to your wishlist now and don't miss out!
[/h2]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532710/Lucy_Dreaming/

notes.notes:

As you will have gathered from the title of this update, we are releasing Lucy Dreaming on 18th October 2022.

It annoys me slightly that this is later than I originally planned (I hate being late!) but we wanted to give adventure game fans a whole month to play Return to Monkey Island and also allow a bit of time for new players to discover the genre. It also has the added benefit of providing me with a few extra weeks to deal with any lingering issues and improvements.

Now go, spread the word, tell anyone who’ll listen and let’s build up a few more wishlists before launch day!

notes.title: Dominic Armato joins Lucy Dreaming cast
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/ea384b11a39290f7915db0af0985b5a772f769a8.jpg[/img]

Honestly, we’ve been sitting on this news for almost 18 months now! Before we even launched our Kickstarter campaign last year, we approached Dominic Armato (a.k.a. Guybrush Threepwood) and asked him if he’d be interested in lending his vocal talents to our new point & click adventure game Lucy Dreaming.

Dom is a brilliant chap. Clever, funny, professional and thoroughly lovely to boot. Although the paperwork involved has been…voluminous…it’s an absolute delight to be able to officially announce his involvement.

[previewyoutube=gYFUyhNUpaU;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]“People tell me they don’t understand why I haven’t worked on other games over the past decade. The truth is, nobody asked! I was thrilled that Tom and Emma were able to make it happen. And a quirky love letter to graphic adventures like Lucy Dreaming felt like just the right opportunity to jump back in.”[/i]
Dominic Armato

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/7c4bdb1aeff0dacffd9ef83f95fbf494531e6b59.jpg[/img]
[i]Dom recording lines for Lucy Dreaming from his closet in Arizona.[/i]

Obviously, this predates the Return to Monkey Island announcements, and even Dom wasn’t aware of it on the horizon when we started working together, so when the news broke we immediately shot him an email to both congratulate him on his reprised role as the most beloved character in our genre, and to double-check that his new trajectory towards further stardom hadn’t put a monkey wrench in the works for us.

Dom reassured us that he was definitely still on board, and we now have everything in the can ready for our fast-approaching release later this year.

[i]“It was a dream come true when Dom agreed to get involved in the game. We wrote a character just for him, inspired by his career as a dining critic. It’s been amazing to work with someone who is so much a part of adventure game history and my own childhood.”[/i]
Tom Hardwidge

Lucy Dreaming is due for release later this year!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532710/Lucy_Dreaming/

notes.title: Lucy Dreaming: A pixel-art point & click adventure
notes.notes:
[h2]Lucy Dreaming is planned for release in Summer 2022!
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/c0114e7116a8a5dbaedfb1850eca3d4b1a5a3fb5.jpg[/img]

[h3]What to expect[/h3]
Lucy Dreaming is a retro point & click adventure with a fully-voiced cast, stunning pixel-art and a witty British sense of humour inspired by the likes of Blackadder and Monty Python.
The full game opens up a myriad of dream worlds with extraordinary characters and logical puzzles as Lucy strives to unearth the disturbing truth behind her nightmares...but before that, she needs to overcome her anxiety and get to sleep.

That's your quest in the Lucy Dreaming demo/prequel, and your springboard into the wider adventure ahead.
[hr][/hr][i][h2]“I don’t think I’ve ever laughed as much playing a game as I did playing this.”[/h2]
[h3]“Lucy Dreaming’s puzzle design is genius, fun and incredibly satisfying to solve. The level of detail afforded to each item in Lucy Dreaming is exquisite and an incredible accomplishment.[/h3][/i]

notes.title: Easter Egg competition ends 30th September
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/a2997adf3502742d1bd0273f4c63e75d6de00926.jpg[/img]

[b]This competition has been running since Easter 2021, and will be closing at the end of September 2021.
[/b]
Find the Easter egg – It is well-hidden in the demo, but there are subtle clues that could point you in the right direction.

Once you find it you’ll be given instructions on how to enter the competition which could land you a starring role in the full game as an interactive NPC (non-player character). 

Not only that, in addition to appearing in the game as a pixel-art character, you will also receive a FREE copy of the full game when it is released, and your name will appear in the credits.

It’s a draw – One person will be picked at random from all of the valid entries using a number generated from random.org. The draw will take place and the winner will be announced before the full game is released – this date is subject to change, but the date for final entries is 30th September 2021.

 If you have any questions about the competition, please contact us via email, Discord or Twitter.

For full details and terms, please visit: https://lucy-dreaming.com/egg/

If you spot anything in one of the new languages which seems out of place, or could be improved, please send us a message. It may be just a demo, but we want it to be the best it can be!

[h2]Saved games[/h2]
Also, we have tested the game saving functionality in the new release against games saved with the previous release and, although we found everything to work correctly when tested, there's a possibility that some saved games may reveal a few bugs with the audio and text outputs. After many months of preparations, we have finally pushed the big, green button on our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hardwidge/lucy-dreaming-a-pixel-art-point-and-click-comedy-adventure]Kickstarter campaign[/url] to fund the full 8-10 hour version of Lucy Dreaming.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hardwidge/lucy-dreaming-a-pixel-art-point-and-click-comedy-adventure][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/5f3a90f5d422bcb13cfb7fa5c282f769a6dc1ce4.png[/img][/url]

As well as helping us to fund our first fully-fledged game, there are loads of digital and physical rewards for you to choose from - plus exclusive opportunities to be immortalised in the pixel-art world of a point & click adventure.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hardwidge/lucy-dreaming-a-pixel-art-point-and-click-comedy-adventure][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/6b9de53532b155903367789aabe4cbe74788b05f.png[/img][/url]

So head on over to our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hardwidge/lucy-dreaming-a-pixel-art-point-and-click-comedy-adventure]Kickstarter page[/url] and help make this dream a reality!

notes.title: Go Easter Egg hunting in the Lucy Dreaming demo, get a chance to appear in the game
notes.notes:
Tall Story Games have announced a fun little Easter Egg hunt in the demo for their upcoming point & click adventure game Luxy Dreaming. It gives you the chance to appear in the game!

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/04/go-easter-egg-hunting-in-the-lucy-dreaming-demo-get-a-chance-to-appear-in-the-game

notes.title: Easter egg hunt
notes.notes:
[url=https://lucy-dreaming.com/egg/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/49becf145eb1495689a8ab5b88cc73acacff0713.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Have you ever wanted to be a character in an adventure game?[/h1]
[h2]Now's your chance![/h2]

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532710/]demo for Lucy Dreaming[/url] contains a well-hidden Easter egg that unlocks the chance to win big.

Its discovery offers adventure gamers a once-in-a-lifetime chance to appear as a pixel-art character in the full release of the game.

Every player who finds the Easter egg is offered the chance to enter a draw where the prize is unlike any other – become an NCP (non-player character) in the full game!

Not only will their likeness be rendered seamlessly into the beautiful, retro pixel-art world of Lucy Dreaming, they will also become an integral part of the game’s story and gameplay. In addition to this, the winner will receive a free digital copy of the full game, a high-resolution digital artwork of their character and a mention in the game’s credits to boot.

[url=https://lucy-dreaming.com/egg/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39934514/12921aab56b4f86a47490c54e564b36fec3e496b.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532710/]Lucy Dreaming[/url] is a comedic, quirky point & click adventure which sees players taking control of the destiny of Lucy, a young girl suffering from recurring nightmares. In the game Lucy unlocks the secrets to controlling her dreams and journeys through a myriad of weird & wonderful locations in both the real world and her dreams. On the way she encounters a cast of extraordinary characters and creatures as she unearths the disturbing truth behind her nightmares.

[h2]So what are you waiting for? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532710/]Go and find that egg![/url][/h2]

[b]Full details can be found on the Lucy Dreaming website: [url=https://lucy-dreaming.com/egg/]https://lucy-dreaming.com/egg/[/url] [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1542220

notes.title: Play the FREE Lucy Dreaming demo now
notes.notes:
We can announce that our first fully-fledged adventure game, Lucy Dreaming, is now available as a demo  with a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hardwidge/lucy-dreaming-a-pixel-art-point-and-click-comedy-adventure/edit/basics]Kickstarter campaign[/url] launching in May.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1542220

This pixel art adventure is laden with irreverent and sardonic British humour inspired by Blackadder and Monty Python, and is bought to life with a wildly entertaining voice cast led by our own studio founder Emma. A love letter to classic LucasArts point & click adventures, the game is unashamedly traditional but with all the modern bells and whistles of other games in the genre.  

[h1]Game features:[/h1]

[list]
[*] Discover a wide variety of detailed dreams and real-world locations from a neon-lit comedy club with an unusual clientele to a post-apocalyptic boulangerie.
[*] Encounter a cast of characters from Lucy’s maniacal brother to a giant duck with a bread problem.
[*] Explore rich environments with an abundance of witty retorts to almost everything you can point your cursor at.
[*] Reveal hidden Easter eggs and pop culture references.
[*] Enjoy the distinctive and beautifully realised voice acting (English)
[*] Travel instantly between scenes with a double-click.
[*] Having trouble? Just hit the space bar to get a sneaky peek of each scene’s hotspots.
[/list]
